releases.notes:
Ideally, this is the final Release Candidate before entering open beta.
I do not believe there are any more changes that need to be done at this point.
During beta the following features will be looked at being added:
- Checking the sign on the barrel as well.
- Handling other barrel types like Buy Only / Sell Only / Rares for example.
- Handling shop specific purchasing (Buy for sell / Sell for buy / Midprice / Manager Balancing for examples).
- Creating and Handling SCInfo.
- - Barrels will be able to indicate the type of item they expect to have so wrong item mistrades can be detected.
- - Barrels will be able to indicate if a swap fee exists which will likely just be the tax.
- More checkpoint handling. Right now checkpoint handling is admittedly bare bones.
- Localization


**Changelog:**

- Changed command structure from /stonkcompanion [argument] to /stonkcompanion (subcommand) (subcommand2)
  - Previously you had arguments like "togglecoreprotect" now it would be /stonkcompanion coreprotect toggle .
- Added Mod Menu Integration.
- Verbose Logging toggle is now in config file.
- Verbose Logging no longer outputs to log file. Instead it is called action logs / interaction logs and they are printed to files in config/StonkCompanion/Interaction files based on barrel coords.
  - Logs are automatically deleted if they are older than the given lifetime upon startup (By default this is 7 days.)
  - This lifetime is currently only incrementable by days and is a minimum of 1 day to a max of 30 days.
- All text messages sent by the mod should now be colored. With mistrades detected and corrections being in red.
- A version notification system is implemented.
  - If your version is less than the latest, you will be notified what the latest is at the top of gui and text when trade information is printed.
  - If your version is less than the minimum required version, then mistrade detection will be stopped. As that means the version being used has a mistrade detection bug that needed to be patched.
- Text trade info no longer prints Sold: 0 if you interacted with only currency. Same for other such cases.
